## Intent — what this is for

Reopens the CRE-6 test-isolation strand: CRE-6 fixed cross-test bleed but a run with no home patch still bound the REAL home. Fixes the two seams every writer reaches the real home through (test-side), converts the three module-level constants that froze a home at import time to call-time resolvers (src-side, the one shape no fixture can reach), and adds the session-scoped detector that fails the run on the next leak.

## Done when

An UNSPECIFIED home resolves to a per-test tmp dir at both seams that reach the real one (config.loader.config_dir, including every module-level binding of that function object, and sel._default_dir), while an EXPLICIT $PERSONALCLAW_HOME — including one pointed deliberately at the real home — and a repointed $HOME/Path.home both pass through untouched, so the real-home refusal rails (test_seed main-home with and without --seed-replace, test_cli_gateway_flags yolo) stay non-vacuous; the three module-level constants that froze a home at IMPORT time — the one shape no fixture can reach — are converted to call-time resolvers in src/ (subagent_persistence._subagents_dir, session_map._sessions_dir, and a dead schedule._DEFAULT_DIR whose import-time config_dir() mkdir'd the real home merely by importing the module), with the two tests that monkeypatched the constant realigned to the new seam rather than weakened; the measured leaks read 0 bytes after the fix (-k "project or memory or knowledge or recall" 44,402 -> 0; test_learning_routes 8,961 -> 0; full suite 26 real-home families / 123 deletions / -151,963 audit-log bytes -> 0), confirmed by BOTH the rail and an independent snapshot diff; a session-scoped rail walks the real home once at pytest_sessionfinish (controller only), NAMES every entry created/modified/grown/deleted during the run and FAILS the session; ALLOWED_RESIDUE is empty and exact-match only (no prefix/glob baseline); an absent real home is reported as "nothing to compare" rather than converted into a failure; and the detector is importable and proven to fire against a fake root under tmp_path (append, create, byte-identical rewrite, deletion-via-parent, symlink non-follow, no-write-during-scan) rather than by writing to the real home to prove a point
